pr_body:

Fixes #31220

review_comments: Why do we need this? Should we fix either PlatformDetection or the capability Instead?
`SocketsHttpHandler` type is not available on the full .Net Framework, so conditional compilation seems to be the only way.
So why type it as `SocketsHttpHandler` rather than `object`, as the other functions this is called from and it's calling are doing?

It's to distinct it from the [other overload taking HttpClientHandler](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/cb60aaa2408f8423d95d3ef03ae5b6f372a1945b/src/libraries/Common/tests/System/Net/Http/TestHelper.cs#L116).
Of course, I could have made it `object`, but think an explicit type is more convenient.
Just a question, why do we need this here?

It enables **unencrypted** HTTP/2 on platforms without ALPN support (e.g. OSX) where we cannot use SSL over HTTP/2. Check [this line](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/35100/files/cb60aaa2408f8423d95d3ef03ae5b6f372a1945b#diff-4210bd74dd22b1469b8bf0307675ed37R139).

So if I get it right, we're using here `SocketsHttpHandler` just because we need to set `Expect100ContinueTimeout`, since `HttpClientHandler` doesn't have such property.
And what we do on these 2 lines here [HttpClientHandlerTest.Http2.cs#L1874-L1875](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/cb60aaa2408f8423d95d3ef03ae5b6f372a1945b/src/libraries/System.Net.Http/tests/FunctionalTests/HttpClientHandlerTest.Http2.cs#L1874-L1875) is pretty much the same as what's done in [HttpClientHandlerTestBase.SocketsHttpHandler.cs#L22-L23](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/cb60aaa2408f8423d95d3ef03ae5b6f372a1945b/src/libraries/System.Net.Http/tests/FunctionalTests/HttpClientHandlerTestBase.SocketsHttpHandler.cs#L22-L23).
